# gpupaas_virtual_machines (Data Source)

List the virtual machines of a project, or of one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The virtual machines of a workspace that are running.
data "gpupaas_virtual_machines" "team_a" {
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
}

output "running_vms" {
  value = [for vm in data.gpupaas_virtual_machines.team_a.items : vm.name if vm.status == "running"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project to list.

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Only the entries of this workspace. Unset lists the whole project, the entries of its workspaces included.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (Attributes List) The virtual machines, sorted by name, with a few identifying fields. Look one up by name for the rest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `names` (List of String) Names of the virtual machines, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `sku` (String) The SKU (profile) it was created from.
- `status` (String) Normalized platform status, such as `running`, `success`, `in_progress`, `failed`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns it; empty for a project-scoped one.
